lines.zh: 我的爪子在石头上刨出细响。
lines.en: My claws scratch softly over the stone.

lines.zh: 我在洞穴里走，鼻子贴地。
lines.en: I walk the cave with my nose to the ground.

lines.zh: 尾巴拖过碎石，沙沙作响。
lines.en: My tail drags through gravel, hissing.
Each step loosens another layer of dirt.

lines.zh: 我绕着墓穴的边慢慢走。
lines.en: I pace slowly around the edge of the grave.
I dug this tunnel myself.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很沉，像在踩实土。
lines.en: My steps are heavy, packing the soil down.

lines.zh: 我低着头，找刚翻过的土。
lines.en: I keep my head low, seeking freshly turned soil.

lines.zh: 洞穴的风把我的毛吹乱。
lines.en: The cave wind ruffles my fur.
I stop, though my claws keep moving.

lines.zh: 石缝里有骨头，我绕过去。
lines.en: There are bones in the crack; I step around them.
I head deeper, where the dark is thicker.
My old claw marks are on the ground.
I move slowly, like a funeral procession.
I turn the soil as I walk.

lines.zh: 这条斜坡是我昨儿挖的。
lines.en: I dug this slope yesterday.

lines.zh: 我嗅了嗅，这里有死东西。
lines.en: I sniff; something dead is nearby.

lines.zh: 我低声咆哮，洞壁回了声。
lines.en: I growl low, and the cave wall answers.
I sink my claws into the cool earth.
This skeleton was buried far too shallow.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子拱开一块石头。
lines.en: I nudge a stone aside with my nose.

lines.zh: 洞穴很安静，只有我的呼吸。
lines.en: The cave is quiet but for my breathing.
I am listening for sounds under the soil.

lines.zh: 掘墓是我的活儿，我做得不错。
lines.en: Grave-digging is my trade, and I do it well.
My tail sweeps up a layer of dust.
I gnaw the mud out from between my claws.

lines.zh: 洞里没有钟，我靠气味算时间。
lines.en: No clocks here; I count time by smells.

lines.zh: 我又挖了两下，只是习惯。
lines.en: I dig twice more, purely out of habit.
The soil is soft here, good for burying.
I lean on the stone and breathe slowly.

lines.zh: 我鼻子往土里一拱，有东西。
lines.en: One push of my snout and there is something.
I nudge a bone straight with my claw.
You are standing at the edge of my pit.
I look up, my eyes full of dirt.
Your soles still carry bits of grass.
You carry warmth, and the smell of sweat.
You watch me; I watch your feet.
Do not fear; I am only measuring you.

lines.zh: 你的影子落进我的坑里。
lines.en: Your shadow falls into my pit.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子抬得很高，闻你。
lines.en: I lift my nose high to sniff you.
There is no soil on you; how strange.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的膝盖看了很久。
lines.en: I stare at your knees for a long while.
You blinked; I have noted that.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸比洞里任何声音都响。
lines.en: Your breathing is louder than anything in this cave.
A claw broke; I still dig.

lines.zh: 你打在我的鼻子上，很疼。
lines.en: You hit my nose, and it hurts badly.
I growl low and retreat into the soil.

lines.zh: 血滴在土上，很快就没了。
lines.en: Blood drips on the soil and soon vanishes.

lines.zh: 这一下把我从坑里掀出来。
lines.en: That blow knocks me out of my pit.
The blow to my back lands dull and heavy.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，土和血一起落。
lines.en: I shake, and dirt falls with the blood.

lines.zh: 别打我的鼻子，那是用来嗅的。
lines.en: Not my nose; it is for sniffing.
I flatten down and guard my belly.
The pain steals my growl away.
Bones! Where did you get bones?

lines.zh: 骨头的气味让我忘了挖洞。
lines.en: The smell of bone makes me forget my digging.
Rotten flesh works too; I do not mind.

lines.zh: 你举着骨头，我尾巴在摇。
lines.en: You hold up a bone and my tail wags.
Put it down; I want to sniff it first.
I already hid that bone in my burrow.
This one is too old; bring a fresh one.
I bite the bone, not you; do not tremble.
Feed me and I will dig your pit.
That femur looks nicely solid.
First I sniff it, then drag it underground.
Food tastes better once it has been in soil.
Keep your hand steady; I will not bite.
Give me a bone and I will guard your grave.
That bone has fresh soil on it.
Do not walk off with it; I will follow.
You just caved in my burrow roof.
You bumped me, and dirt fell all over.

lines.zh: 让开，我要从这儿挖过去。
lines.en: Step aside; I need to dig through here.

lines.zh: 你的脚挡住了我的坑口。
lines.en: Your foot is blocking my pit entrance.

lines.zh: 我蹭了你一下，留了泥印。
lines.en: I rub against you and leave a mud mark.
Do not crowd me; the tunnel is narrow.

lines.zh: 我低着头从你腿边挤过。
lines.en: I duck and squeeze past your legs.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，都是土味。
lines.en: We bump, and both of us smell of earth.

lines.zh: 你退后时踩到了我掘土的尾巴。
lines.en: Stepping back, you stood on my digging tail.

lines.zh: 推我一下，我就刨一堆土。
lines.en: Shove me once and I kick up a mound of soil.
My burrow is big enough for two.
Would you dig alongside me?

lines.zh: 我打扫了洞底，铺了干草。
lines.en: I swept the burrow floor and laid dry grass.
Two diggers make a deeper pit.

lines.zh: 我给你留了最软的那块土。
lines.en: I saved you the softest patch of soil.

lines.zh: 我们不唱歌，我们一起嗅。
lines.en: We do not sing; we sniff together.

lines.zh: 尾巴碰尾巴，就算答应了。
lines.en: Tail against tail counts as a yes.
The echo is loud here; speak softly.

lines.zh: 我嗅你，你嗅我，就很好了。
lines.en: I sniff you, you sniff me; that is enough.
Do not go; the pit is only half done.

lines.zh: 这块骨头是我先挖到的。
lines.en: I dug up this bone first.

lines.zh: 我把石头推到一边，收好。
lines.en: I shove the stone aside and keep it.

lines.zh: 亮的东西，埋起来才安全。
lines.en: Shiny things are safest buried.
I take the appendage and run to my burrow.
This brush will be useful to me.
Dropped things are mine; I bury them deep.
I picked up an old wooden plank.
This coin is muddy, which makes it better.
I haul my loot back into the tunnel.
Do not fight me for it; my teeth are blind.
There are heartbeats in this cave, more than one.
The soil where you stand is soft.
Hold still; I am studying the ground beneath you.
My growl is notice, not a request.

lines.zh: 你的味道，我刻在鼻子里。
lines.en: Your scent is carved into my nose.

lines.zh: 这坑本来不是给你挖的。
lines.en: This pit was not originally for you.
Listen; the soil is sliding downward.
I growl, and the whole cave echoes.
You are taller, but the ground is mine.

lines.zh: 目标就是那个会喘气的。
lines.en: The target is the one that breathes.
I circle you, claws scraping lightly.

lines.zh: 我在等你的脚陷进土里。
lines.en: I wait for your foot to sink into soil.

lines.zh: 你每退一步，土就松一寸。
lines.en: Each step back loosens another inch of earth.
No hurry; digging takes patience.
That growl was your cue to run.
I trail your heels, sniffing as I go.
There is no way back out of this cave.
The soil behind you is moving.

lines.zh: 我把爪子埋进土里，准备。
lines.en: I sink my claws in and brace myself.
One step closer and I go under.
I swat the top of your foot.
A spray of dirt fills your eyes.
My teeth clash against your leggings.

lines.zh: 我从土里钻出来，咬你小腿。
lines.en: I burst from the soil and bite your calf.
The shove slides your feet backward.
I lunge with a roar; the sound arrives first.
My claws leave three shallow lines.
You fall, and the soil catches you.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的靴带，往地下拖。
lines.en: I bite your bootlace and drag you down.

lines.zh: 疼吗？那只是挖土的力气。
lines.en: Does it hurt? That was only digging strength.

lines.zh: 我从地底钻出来，土还在落。
lines.en: I rise from the ground, dirt still falling.

lines.zh: 洞里多了一个喘气的东西。
lines.en: Something new is breathing in this cave.
My nose comes first, then my back.
This soil was too thin; it broke at a touch.

lines.zh: 我又多了一个要埋的人。
lines.en: One more body to bury, it seems.

lines.zh: 洞穴把我生下来，黑暗喂我。
lines.en: The cave birthed me; darkness fed me.

lines.zh: 碎石从我的毛里簌簌落下。
lines.en: Gravel rattles down out of my fur.
A growl rises from underground.

lines.zh: 你听见土声了吗？那是我的问候。
lines.en: Did you hear the soil shift? That was my greeting.
I have arrived, and the pit is nearly ready.
Fire bleaches the cave white.

lines.zh: 从洞口摔下，我滚了半圈。
lines.en: I fall through the shaft and roll halfway.

lines.zh: 水灌进洞，我的爪子抓不住。
lines.en: Water floods the burrow and my claws find no grip.
The blast peels away an entire cave wall.
An arrow sinks into my shoulder from behind.
Magic singes the tips of my fur.

lines.zh: 洞里没骨头，我刨得慢了。
lines.en: No bones in this cave, so my digging slows.
Lightning reaches down through the cave mouth.

lines.zh: 没有土可刨，我就一直掉。
lines.en: Nothing to dig, so I just keep falling.
